raw_comment:
I notice that there a lot of droughts near the Midwest and in the middle of the US. I also noticed that because the middle of the US is not near any water there tend to be more droughts.

I wonder how communities that experience droughts deal with it. I also wonder how have drought levels changed over time.
This relates to me and my community because as a nationwide we can work on preventing droughts and in New York it is usually dry so we can work on it.
